blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte’s admission that he was unaware that his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, holds an interest in GenCorp Industries Inc. amounted to a “confession.” That’s according to private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan who on Tuesday also argued that it showed his failure to exercise “due diligence.” GenCorp Industries Inc. is among the companies being tackled in the vice president’s impeachment trial, particularly on her alleged unexplained wealth. The company also has extensive links to Davao City through multiple local government contracts. READ: Baste Duterte ‘unaware’ sister Sara holds interest in GenCorp Industries Days before […]...
